lessons: Derived data dated by when it was fetched rather than by what it contains will serve half a session as a whole one.
A parser that correctly rejects bad input, upstream of a cache that does not, produces the quietest possible failure: the data is dropped where it is noticed and the hit is reported where it is not.
A fault found on one market is worth generalising before the next market finds it independently: the Bursa blank row and the US mid-session fetch are the same page-level defect one day apart.
